name: Mind Assemble Circlet

statsTables.title: Mind Assemble Circlet
rows: Whenever the wearer uses a psychic power, they can trigger one of the following: 50% chance to reduce the AP cost and decrease veil degradation by -2 25% chance to perform the psychic power as usual 25% chance to increase veil degradation by +3 and reset the cooldown of their attack If veil degradation is increased to 15 or beyond, this effect triggers perils of the warp even when using minor psychic powers.
